invariants.rationale: If this component has keyboard focus, it always returns true. Otherwise, it returns the result of super.keyDown.
If result is true, then either hasKeyboardFocus is true or super.keyDown is true, reflecting the key return logic.
If the key pressed was not UP or DOWN, moveOffset is set to -1, otherwise one of those keys must be pressed.
The result is true if keyboard focus is held; otherwise, the result depends on the superclass.
If keyboard focus is not held, the result must match the superclass method's result.
